pages_read.note: 兄弟 (siblings): per star, counts + 和 / 不和; the counts are not used.
子女 (children): mostly counts, sex and 刑克; used: 貴子 / 不成器 / 強橫敗家.
奴仆 (servants, subordinates, friends of lower rank): 得力 / 欠力 / 背主 / 怨主 / 一呼百諾.
父母: mostly 刑克 (death of a parent) and adoption; used: 榮貴, 庇蔭, 破父財, 欠和.
